title: Two Men Arrested In Karnataka For Displaying Swords During Birthday Celebration | Video | Bengaluru-news News - News18
text: What was supposed to be a joyous birthday celebration turned into a lesson for two young men in Karnataka’s Belagavi district, who were arrested by police for displaying swords during the party. The incident occurred on the outskirts of M.K. Hubballi town, within the Kittur police station limits. According to the police, a man named Tabrez Hanif Qadri brought his friend, Zaid Noor Ahmed Sanadi, on a Yamaha R15 bike to the venue of celebration. Five cakes were placed on a Honda Shine bike. Zaid, who allegedly carried a sword while riding to the venue, got off the motorcycle and cut the cake. https://images.news18.com/ibnlive/uploads/2026/02/WhatsApp-Video-2026-02-26-at-9.38.18-AM-2026-02-4c1bded6c03e059ede9a8b269b41786d.mp4 The act was recorded on camera and later uploaded on Instagram by a user named Rehan Mustaq Ahmad Badeghar, who was reportedly involved in the celebration. After noticing the video on social media, Kittur police took suo-motu cognizance and registered a case under Sections 25 and 27 of the Indian Arms Act, 1959. The accused were later arrested and remanded to judicial custody.
